items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: One little group that I played with, I can't remember whether it was before I started playing with Paul Mollier, whether it was shortly afterwards, before I had gone to St. Louis, but there was Mr. Mineta, a fellow named Red Dugas playing drums.

ctx.x: We can get that part of the story then from her. Yes. You were going to tell about this story about...

One little group that I played with, I can't remember whether it was before I started playing with Paul Mollier, whether it was shortly afterwards, before I had gone to St. Louis, but there was Mr. Mineta, a fellow named Red Dugas playing drums. Oh yeah. A trombone player, his name was Freddie Babu.
Yeah, maybe heard the name, but I don't know anything about him. Freddie Babu. Yeah. I played some bandages, somebody might have mentioned that.
